thread.title: Sonos IPO: Patented Technology And 10% Revenue Growth In 2017 - Sonos, Inc. (Pending:SONO)

author: Wilsonville Capital
title: Sonos IPO: Patented Technology And 10% Revenue Growth In 2017 - Sonos, Inc. (Pending:SONO)
text:
Commercializing wireless multi-room home audio, Sonos ( SONO ) is revolutionizing the way clients listen to music throughout the home. With 6.9 million houses already registered by Sonos, 10% revenue growth in 2017 and a lot of R&D expenditures, the business is quite promising.
Source: S-1 Filing
The fact that relevant underwriters like Goldman Sachs (NYSE: GS ), Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS ), or Jefferies (NYSE: JEF ) are working on the new IPO tells a lot about the standards of Sonos:
Source: S-1 Filing
Innovative Business Model With Patents Incorporated in Delaware in 2002 and headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, Sonos provides wireless multi-room home audio. The company casts its activities with the following words in the annual report:
“Sonos transforms the way people live and interact by restoring the shared experience of music throughout the home. Our home sound system provides an immersive listening experience created by our thoughtfully designed speakers and components, our proprietary software platform and the ability to wirelessly stream the content our customers love from the services they prefer.” Source: S-1 Filing
How can the company capitalize on the development of home audio? According to Sonos, new streaming services and rapid adoption of voice assistants are changing audio consumption habits and how consumers interact with the internet. With this new environment, the company seems to be providing a completely new way of choosing home entertainment.
How is the company able to capitalize on this change? With 630 issued patents and 570 applications, it seems to have the know-how and technology necessary to grow the business. Research on Google Patents shows the large amount of patents owned by Sonos. The number of patents assigned seem to be larger than 630 as shown in the image below:
Source: patents.google.com
With that, the company has also a network of partners that provide different content to the users. Approximately 100 streaming content providers such as Apple Music, Apple ( OTC:APPL ), Pandora (NYSE: P ), Spotify (NYSE: SPOT ) and TuneIn collaborate with Sonos.
Source: sonos.com
The following is information about some of the products currently being sold by Sonos. There is also additional information on sonos.com :
Source: S-1 Filing
Is the company selling a lot of items? According to the prospectus, as of March 31, 2018 the company had registered over 19 million products in 6.9 million houses around the world. The following charts are also quite impressive:
Source: S-1 Filing
With this information in mind, it is worth mentioning that according to the S-1 filing, the company has experienced 12 consecutive years of sustained revenue growth since the first product was launched.
Who are the competitors of Sonos? The company competes with large corporations like Bang & Olufsen ( OTCPK:BGOUF ), Samsung SDI Co. Ltd. ADR ( OTC:SSDIY ), Sony Corporation (NYSE: SNE ), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ), Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), or Google (NASDAQ: GOOG ). The image below provides further information:
Source: S-1 Filing
Market Opportunity Experts estimate that global paid subscribers to streaming music services will grow from 176 million in 2017 to 293 million by 2021. In addition, Nielsen also notes that the number of hours spent listening to music per week in the US increased by 37% in two years to over 32 hours in 2017. Check the following text for further information:
Source: S-1 Filing
A Lot of Employees Working On R&D With 1,478 employes as of March 31, 2018, it is remarkable that 549 employees of the company are working on R&D tasks. This seems to be the most important difference between a company selling home audio devices and Sonos. The following lines provide more information:
Source: S-1 Filing
10% y/y Revenue Growth The revenue growth seemed to accelerate recently. Sonos reported revenue of $843 million and $901 million in 2015 and 2016 respectively. The increase represents only 6% y/y. With that, the company reported revenue of $992 million as of September 30, 2017 showing revenue growth of 10% y/y. The following image provides more information:
Source: S-1 Filing
The company is not returning positive net income. However, it is worth mentioning that Sonos is expending a lot in research and development. The R&D expenses were equal to 12% and 11% its annual revenues in 2017 and 2016, respectively. These expenses will help provide better services and sustain revenue growth.
Positive and Growing CFO The upward trend in the cash flow provided by operations is also beneficial. The CFO has gone from $38.6 million in 2015 to $63.9 million in 2017, which represents 65% increase in two years. More information can be found in the image below:
Source: S-1 Filing
Assets and Liabilities From the assets provided, the most interesting is the cash in hand. As of March 31, 2018, the company reported $117 million in cash and cash equivalents, which represents 33% of the total amount of assets. The following image provides more information in this regard: Source: S-1 Filing
With that, it is also beneficial that the total long-term debt is small, at $39 million, and the amount of liabilities is not significant. As of March 31, 2018, the company reported liabilities of $225 million:
Source: S-1 Filing
It is also worth mentioning that Sonos will have to pay $175 million for contractual commitments in less than a year. Specifically, the company signed agreements with suppliers to acquire $143 million in inventory:
Source: S-1 Filing
To finish with the liability front, it is mandatory to comment about the high interest rates paid by Sonos. The company has loans with interest rates over LIBOR plus 10%. Why are the debt investors asking for high rates if the company has small amounts of debt? Have a look at it in the image below:
Source: S-1 Filing
Convertible Preferred Stock Will Be Converted After the IPO The investors checking the prospectus superficially will not appreciate $90.3 million in convertible preferred stock shown in the balance sheet as of March 31, 2018. These are dilutive securities that could reduce the value of the stock.
Source: S-1 Filing
With that, my readers and those studying the prospectus in detail will learn that the preferred stock will be converted right after the IPO. Have a look at the following lines for further information:
Source: S-1 Filing
Use of Proceeds While the company did not provide a lot of specific information about the use of proceeds from the IPO, it is beneficial that it will not be used to pay the debt:
Source: S-1 Filing
After checking the balance sheet and the contractual obligations, it seems more logical that Sonos uses the IPO money to pay for the acquisition of $143 million in inventory.
Repurchase of Stock and KKR is a Shareholder The following is the list of shareholders. Note that private equity investor KKR (NYSE: KKR ) is among stockholdersk. The firm owns 25.7% before the offering:
Source: S-1 Filing
With that, the investors will appreciate the following information about two tender offers that took place in 2014 and 2015. In the first tender, the company acquired 3.83 million shares. Several executive officers and shareholders sold stock for an aggregate total price of $130 million. The following lines contain more information:
Source: S-1 Filing
Additionally, in 2016, the company acquired 0.3 million of shares for an aggregate total repurchase price of $8.8 million.
Source: S-1 Filing
Stock repurchases represent a beneficial feature. They usually show that the business is doing great. The company has cash in hand that it has decided to pay to shareholders.
Conclusion With an innovative business model, growing CFO and remarkable shareholders, Sonos IPO is poised to receive a lot attention from the market. With that, the fact that the company hired some of the most prestigious underwriters on the street tells a lot about its future.
Disclosure: I/we have no positions in any stocks mentioned, and no plans to initiate any positions within the next 72 hours.
